gnosh prompt export

  Write gnosh's own texts into the folder yours go in, to edit them. With no
  name, every text. A file that is there is kept unless --force is given. An
  exported text changes nothing until its words are changed: its first line
  marks it as gnosh's own, and is never sent.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh prompt export [flags] [name...]

Flags
  --force
      Write over a file of that name that is there already. (Not built yet.)
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
